steps.content: You finally break out of the fog. The light that guided you flickers twice inside the fog, then leaps into a blind zone.
The sound of shears continues to linger in the fog, refusing to give up the chase.
Street lights still illuminate the main road, making it still possible to tell the direction.
As you try to hide, you catch sight of a strange tricolor "street light" out of the corner of your eye.
Yet in that moment of distraction, you get knocked to the ground by the monster. With a flash of cold light, the shears pin down your collar.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: It's was you... You took my shears...
It twists and wriggles, as if trying to break free from some kind of pain. The shear blades carve deep crevices into the ground alongside its movements.

options: I don't remember doing something like that!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I don't remember you at all!

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: You don't remember?!! How can you not remember?!! I can't forget any of it... how can you?! Ahhh how can you?!

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: Just as I thought, you have my shears. You stole them from me. You freed yourself, but what about me?!

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: I'm still entangled. I can't cut it off no matter what. It's all your fault!
You start to get angry at all the false accusations.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Look at what's in your hands! And you've the gall to demand things from an empty-handed person like me?

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: The shears in my hand recognize you! The shears say it's you!
More slashes come your way. It's completely ignoring your words, eyes brimming with resentment and madness. It's pointless to try to talk to it. You can only dodge and pray for the best.
